new.n: A Portage miser's $5,450 dug up under the kitchen, North Cass Street (1903)
new.pl: Cottage on North Cass Street, Portage; house not identified.
new.st: In June 1903, at the widow's request, the district attorney and a justice searched the humble cottage of a Portage miser who had lived like the poorest people. Under the kitchen floor, in the ground, they dug up $5,450, mostly gold, with two notes from his daughters. A bitter family fight over the estate followed. Recovered by the estate; urban lot.
new.t: Found and recovered in 1903; urban, look-only.
src: Baraboo News Republic, 19 Jun 1903, p. 1, 'Find Buried Money' (Newspapers.com 867655895)
Beaver Dam Argus, 25 Jun 1903, p. 2; Stoughton Courier, 26 Jun 1903, p. 2 (reprints)
pinev: Street named (North Cass Street), no house number; pin on the north half of Cass St, Portage.
new.tovw: Lead grade F (treasure thread): recovered by the estate in 1903; urban look-only marker
